Anita (AE): Need approval: one-time deployment credit request for MedFlow Inc. They want 40% off setup + Net60 first invoice due to internal procurement. Quote Q-2026-6011.
Liam (Finance): Net60 is against policy. Need ARR and cost impact. 40% setup seems high.
Anita (AE): ARR for committed seats $180k. Setup = $25k pre-discount. 40% -> $10k credit. Forecasted gross margin remains ~38%.
Priya (CSM): They require white-glove onboarding (onsite week 1) which adds cost. We can offer remote onboarding instead to reduce cost.
Hannah (Legal): Procurement pushed Net60, but legal can accept conditional terms: credit applied only if payment of invoice #1 within Net30. Sounds like a compromise.
Liam (Finance): If credit is conditional and we get AR sign-off for temporary Net60 on invoice #1 only, I can approve the one-time credit at 40% capped. Please provide PO and updated quote.
Anita (AE): Uploaded PO and updated quote to shared drive: https://redwood.shared/medflow/po.pdf. Will send conditional clause.
BillingBot: Draft invoice created INV-2026-7790 (credit pending).
Liam (Finance): AR approved temporary Net60 for this customer (ref AR-EX-2026-55). Final finance approval granted for conditional 40% one-time setup credit.
Anita (AE): Thanks team — will finalize with customer and confirm onboarding plan.
Priya (CSM): Noted. Scheduling remote onboarding week 1.
BillingBot: Applied credit to draft INV-2026-7790. Status: pending send.
